title: Хроническая энтеропатия собак и кошек

terminology.syndromeRule: Хроническая энтеропатия — группа длительных или рецидивирующих GI-состояний; симптомы сами по себе не создают IBD.
terminology.ibdRule: Термин IBD резервируется для стойкой клиники с histologic inflammation неизвестной причины после разумного исключения имитаторов и оценки ответа.
terminology.dietRule: Диетическая проба хранит therapeutic category, полную предыдущую diet history, exclusivity, достаточный срок, weekly score и authored outcome; простая смена корма пробой не считается.
terminology.pleRule: PLE требует enteric protein-loss context после исключения renal, hepatic и значимой bleeding loss; тяжёлая hypoalbuminemia сокращает эмпирические ступени.
terminology.histologyRule: Histology хранит sites, sample quality и standardized report и интерпретируется с клиникой; normal ultrasound не исключает microscopic disease.
terminology.felineRule: У кошки слово triaditis не создаёт enteropathy, pancreatitis и cholangitis без отдельных доказательств каждой системы.
terminology.protocolRule: Контент не задаёт препарат, дозу, конкретный состав рациона, endoscopy/biopsy technique или immunomodulatory protocol.

commonHistoryQuestions.text: Сколько длится проблема и бывают ли полностью нормальные периоды?
Что преобладает: рвота, диарея или изменение аппетита?
Каковы объём, частота, слизь, свежая кровь, мелена или жирность стула?
Как быстро менялись масса и мышцы?
Что пациент ел за последние месяцы, включая лакомства, стол, добавки и чужие миски?
Какие диеты пробовали, как долго и насколько эксклюзивно?
Какие паразитарные или pathogen tests выполнялись и каким методом?
Есть ли отёки или увеличение живота?
Есть ли PU/PD, кашель, желтуха, боль или другие внекишечные признаки?
Какие лекарства применялись, как долго и с каким ответом?
Есть ли другие животные или люди с похожими симптомами?
Реально ли обеспечить раздельное кормление, строгую диету и журнал?

sourceCatalog.title: ACVIM-endorsed consensus statement on chronic inflammatory enteropathy in dogs
Merck Veterinary Manual: Chronic Enteropathies in Small Animals
Canine Chronic Enteropathy: Current State of the Art

variants.title: Пищевой ответ при хронической энтеропатии
variants.diagnosticTruth: Стабильный пациент с chronic GI signs существенно ремиттирует на полноценной эксклюзивной therapeutic diet с измеренным authored response.

presentations.complaint: Диарея продолжается неделями, но масса и albumin стабильны и системных red flags нет.

examFindings.finding: No severe weight, protein-loss or systemic red flag.
Therapeutic category differs meaningfully from prior exposure.

investigations.result: Authored exclusive trial and weekly outcome.

followUp.timing: weekly score and protocol-defined adequate trial checkpoint

outcomes.safe: A valid diet trial is measured without over-testing a stable patient.
outcomes.unsafe: A random food purchase or two-day response decides the case.

ownerCommunication: List every access that breaks exclusivity and explain weekly measurement.

presentations.complaint: Рвота или смешанные GI-признаки сохраняются после нескольких коротких и неэксклюзивных смен корма.

examFindings.finding: Category, duration or exclusivity was inadequate.
Nutrition safety overrides adherence to a chosen product.

investigations.result: Distinct category, exclusivity and authored outcome.

followUp.timing: early appetite safety check plus adequate trial endpoint

outcomes.safe: A real trial replaces chaotic food switching without sacrificing intake.
outcomes.unsafe: The selected diet is forced despite anorexia.

ownerCommunication: Provide a feasible separation plan and instructions if intake falls.

presentations.complaint: При подтверждённой эксклюзивности weekly score, стул/рвота и масса объективно улучшились.

examFindings.finding: Authored response existed before player diet choice.
Further testing is decision-relevant only.

outcomes.safe: Food response is proven and monitored without unnecessary invasive testing.
outcomes.unsafe: Improvement is claimed without exclusivity or triggers automatic biopsy.

ownerCommunication: Explain what the response proves and how future challenge/transition will be reviewed.

variants.title: Хроническая воспалительная энтеропатия тонкой кишки
variants.diagnosticTruth: Стойкая small-intestinal enteropathy после разумного исключения mimics и адекватных diet trials; histologic inflammation поддерживает диагноз только вместе с клиникой.

presentations.complaint: Большой объём стула, рвота и постепенная потеря массы/мышц указывают на small-intestinal pattern.

examFindings.finding: Fecal, systemic, EPI and nutritional causes remain active.
Patient need can shorten empirical steps.

followUp.timing: staged diagnostic and same-scale weight/score checkpoints

outcomes.safe: The small-bowel phenotype receives proportionate staged workup.
outcomes.unsafe: Chronic diarrhea is called IBD before mimics or diet assessment.

ownerCommunication: Explain the staged route and why rapid loss may justify earlier specialist testing.

presentations.complaint: Несколько разумных diet categories не дали ремиссии при подтверждённых exclusivity, duration и weekly scores.

examFindings.finding: Category, duration, exclusivity and score all documented.
Parasites, EPI, endocrine, pancreatic and hepatic causes remain reviewed.

outcomes.safe: Valid diet failures lead to focused staging instead of endless food changes.
outcomes.unsafe: Short nonexclusive changes are called failure or random diets continue forever.

ownerCommunication: Show which trials were valid and what unanswered question the next test addresses.

presentations.complaint: Adequate multi-site biopsies поддерживают inflammatory enteropathy и согласуются с clinical pattern.

examFindings.finding: Inflammation is not read from a label alone.
Outcome follows patient score, weight and response.

followUp.timing: specialist protocol with clinical, weight and laboratory checkpoints

outcomes.safe: Biopsy evidence is contextual and outcome remains patient-centered.
outcomes.unsafe: A histology adjective alone selects severity or a drug regimen.

ownerCommunication: Explain what biopsy supports, its sampling limits and how response will be measured.

variants.title: Энтеропатия с потерей белка
variants.diagnosticTruth: Hypoalbuminemia связана с enteric loss после исключения renal, hepatic и значимой bleeding loss; phenotype может включать inflammation, lymphangiectasia или infiltration.

presentations.complaint: Albumin снижен, масса и мышцы теряются на фоне хронических GI-признаков.

examFindings.finding: Urine, liver and significant bleeding sources are assessed.
Poor BCS/MCS and albumin trend justify early GI route.

followUp.timing: early serial albumin/weight/score and specialist checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Protein loss is localized and severe cases advance quickly.
outcomes.unsafe: Low albumin is called PLE without urine/liver/bleeding review.

ownerCommunication: Explain why low albumin can come from several systems and why severity changes the pace.

presentations.complaint: На фоне тяжёлой hypoalbuminemia появились отёки, асцит, дыхательный или thrombotic concern.

examFindings.finding: Respiration, perfusion, fluid and coagulation risks are explicit.
Risk and referral are authored, not drugs/rates.

outcomes.safe: Severe PLE complications trigger monitored hospital care.
outcomes.unsafe: Patient waits through several diet experiments or code invents infusion/thrombosis treatment.

ownerCommunication: Explain immediate fluid/respiratory/thrombotic risks and why treatment details require a hospital protocol.

presentations.complaint: Imaging и/или histology поддерживают lymphangiectasia или тяжёлую diffuse mucosal disease.

examFindings.finding: No single ultrasound sign or biopsy label acts alone.
Code does not prescribe low-fat composition to every patient.

outcomes.safe: PLE phenotype is evidenced and monitored without universal treatment generation.
outcomes.unsafe: One imaging sign produces lymphangiectasia and a universal diet.

ownerCommunication: Explain the phenotype, prognosis uncertainty and why diet/other management depends on specialist review.

variants.title: Хроническая толстокишечная энтеропатия или колит
variants.diagnosticTruth: Частые малые порции, слизь, fresh blood и tenesmus локализуют large bowel, но не определяют причину.

presentations.complaint: Частые малые порции стула со слизью, свежей кровью и тенезмами при сохранной или умеренно изменённой массе.

examFindings.finding: Rectal, fecal, diet and severity assessment remain required.
Black digested blood does not stay in this branch.

outcomes.unsafe: Fresh blood alone triggers heavy systemic therapy or melena is mislocalized.

ownerCommunication: Explain that fresh blood often localizes the problem but does not identify its cause.

presentations.complaint: Reviewed diet/fiber strategy при подтверждённом соблюдении улучшила large-bowel weekly score.

historyAnswers.complete_diet_access: No hidden additions or authored lapse.

examFindings.finding: A random supplement is not a diagnostic trial.
Generator does not create a new random disease.

outcomes.safe: Defined nutritional response is tracked longitudinally.
outcomes.unsafe: Any fiber addition counts as trial or relapse generates a new disease.

ownerCommunication: Explain the defined strategy, how to log it and how lapses affect interpretation.

presentations.complaint: Молодая predisposed dog или пациент с тяжёлой кровью/потерей массы не ответил на базовый large-bowel pathway.

historyAnswers.medication_response: Prior empirical use and response recorded.

examFindings.finding: Targeted culture/molecular/histology evidence is still required.
No broad empirical loop.

outcomes.safe: Breed and severity trigger targeted evidence, not automatic treatment.
outcomes.unsafe: Breed alone creates diagnosis or empirical antibiotics recur indefinitely.

ownerCommunication: Explain predisposition versus confirmation and why a targeted test changes treatment.

variants.title: Кошачья хроническая энтеропатия с сочетанной болезнью
variants.diagnosticTruth: Кошачья хроническая GI-болезнь может сосуществовать с pancreatic/hepatobiliary disease, но каждая система требует собственного evidence.

presentations.complaint: Кошка хронически рвёт, худеет или меняет аппетит; бытовое объяснение «кошки иногда рвут» недостаточно.

historyAnswers.extraintestinal_signs: PU/PD, jaundice, pain and other clues.

examFindings.finding: Age-specific systemic and GI workup is required.
Intake safety can override staged diet testing.

investigations.result: GI, biliary, pancreatic and structural context.

followUp.timing: early intake/weight checkpoint and staged results

outcomes.safe: Chronic feline signs receive age-appropriate workup and nutrition protection.
outcomes.unsafe: Vomiting is normalized or a diet trial continues through anorexia.

ownerCommunication: Explain how to count vomiting and food intake and why chronic weight change is not normal.

presentations.complaint: Есть отдельные признаки intestinal, hepatobiliary и/или pancreatic disease, которые частично перекрываются.

examFindings.finding: Intestinal, biliary and pancreatic propositions remain distinct.
Triaditis is not an automatic three-diagnosis label.

investigations.result: GI, biliary and pancreatic findings separated.

outcomes.safe: Each system is evidenced and threats/nutrition are prioritized.
outcomes.unsafe: Triaditis or one marker creates all diagnoses and treatments.

ownerCommunication: Explain which evidence belongs to each system and which problem is currently most urgent.

presentations.complaint: Cobalamin снижен одновременно с потерей массы/мышц и хроническими GI-признаками.

examFindings.finding: Underlying enteric/EPI/pancreatic disease remains assessed.
Outcome includes both clinical and laboratory response.

outcomes.safe: Cobalamin is corrected and monitored while cause remains investigated.
outcomes.unsafe: Low cobalamin becomes the etiologic diagnosis or a generated dosing scheme.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the low value is important but usually points to an underlying absorption problem.

variants.title: Рефрактерная энтеропатия или заболевание-имитатор
variants.diagnosticTruth: Refractory classification возможна только после аудита полного staged path; ошибочная гипотеза, mimic, inadequate trial/sample или true refractory disease остаются отдельными состояниями.

presentations.complaint: Симптомы названы рефрактерными, но parasite/pathogen test был неподходящим или TLI не выполнен при совместимом pattern.

examFindings.finding: Targeted repeat precedes higher-risk treatment.
Patient identity and completed data persist.

outcomes.safe: Missing mimics are closed before risky refractory treatment.
outcomes.unsafe: One negative test allows immunosuppression or a positive mimic loses history.

ownerCommunication: Explain which earlier test was insufficient and why the targeted repeat changes safety.

presentations.complaint: Focal mass, loss of wall layers, abnormal nodes или ambiguous histology вызывают concern lymphoma/infiltration.

examFindings.finding: No single ultrasound or ambiguous biopsy result is definitive.
Reclassification does not discard current care.

followUp.timing: specialist pathology/staging checkpoint with nutrition monitoring

outcomes.safe: Lymphoma concern gets adequate contextual pathology and continuity of care.
outcomes.unsafe: One ambiguous report excludes or confirms lymphoma by itself.

ownerCommunication: Explain why additional pathology may be needed and what remains uncertain.

presentations.complaint: Signs сохраняются после документированных diet trials, mimic screen, imaging и adequate histology/staging.

examFindings.finding: Diet, mimics, structure, sample quality and co-disease are all documented.
Code cannot combine antibiotic, steroid and supplements ad hoc.

followUp.timing: versioned specialist plan with scheduled objective checkpoints

outcomes.safe: Refractory disease is proven and managed through a versioned specialist plan.
outcomes.unsafe: Incomplete workup receives a random multi-drug stack.

ownerCommunication: Explain what has genuinely been ruled out, what remains uncertain and how the next plan will be measured.

familyValidationRules: Reject if chronic GI signs alone create an IBD diagnosis.
Reject if a diet change counts as a valid trial without category, full diet history, exclusivity, duration, score and authored outcome.
Reject PLE without excluding material renal, hepatic and bleeding losses.
Reject if normal ultrasound excludes microscopic disease or histology loses site and sample quality.
Reject if feline enteropathy, pancreatitis and cholangitis are opened by one triaditis label without separate evidence.
Reject if the generator creates a drug, dose, diet composition, biopsy technique or immunomodulatory protocol.
